Built for a Sustainable Future

Every component of Verdis is designed with environmental impact as a first-class protocol feature.

⛓️
Carbon-Native Protocol
On-chain carbon credits, immutable reforestation logging, and verified CO₂ offset tracking built directly into the consensus layer.
🟢
Green Validator Scoring
DPoS validators are scored by renewable energy usage. Eco-first consensus rewards sustainable infrastructure with higher block production.
💱
Native AMM DEX
Built-in decentralized exchange with 6 liquidity pools. Trade VRS, CARBON, ECO, TREE, GREEN, and REDD tokens permissionlessly.
📜
Smart Contract VM
Stack-based virtual machine with 22 opcodes. Deploy contracts via visual drag-and-drop builder or assembly editor.
👛
Native Wallet
Built-in wallet with secp256k1 cryptography and Keccak256 addressing. No MetaMask, no browser injection — fully standalone.
🔐
Enterprise Security
Rate limiting, admin authentication, replay protection, nonce tracking, validator slashing, and tamper detection at protocol level.

🌱 Why Verdis is Truly the First Fully Green Ecosystem

Other blockchains claim to be green because they use less energy. Verdis makes environmental regeneration a core protocol feature. Carbon credits minted on-chain, reforestation logged immutably, validators scored by renewable energy use, and a 5B VRS Carbon Offset Fund. The chain doesn't just consume less — it actively heals the planet through every block produced.
